Monthly Reservoir Releases
VS.
Frequency That Release is Exceeded in Percent
1. These graphs show what changes are expected in the monthly releases through Falcon and Amistad Dams into the Rio Grande channel below each. It should be noted that these are monthly totals of releases  not a uniform rate of flow. Study A and Study B are defined on Plate IV-1.
2. Explanation of Amistad Reservoir Graph. This graph shows that the maximum release for either the present condition or the proposed condition will be about the same (i.e., while passing flood flows). Minimum releases for present conditions will be zero; but minimum releases for the proposed condition will be 2,000 acre-feet in any month. In general, monthly flows will be more uniform under the proposed condition than under the present condition. For example, for the proposed condition, 50,000 acre-feet will be released into the Rio Grande below Amistad for about 92 percent of all months; and for the present condition, 50,000 acre-feet will be releases about 77 percent of all months.
3. Explanation of Falcon Reservoir Graph. This graph shows that there will be no significant difference in monthly releases below Falcon Reservoir whether or not hydropower facilities are added to Amistad Dam.
4. Summary of Graphs on Plate IV-3. Monthly releases into the Rio Grande below Amistad Dam will be more uniform. Monthly releases into the Rio Grande below Falcon Dam will be unchanged.
